note: Seasons that do not end a team's major (FBS) span. Howell's byconf.htm ends a span on any season he doesn't list for a team, and a team's list starts at its latest span (windowStartOf), so a season the team sat out would cut off everything before it. Every season here is one where the team fielded no varsity team (WWII 1943-45, COVID 2020, SMU's death penalty, UAB's shutdown), played only an unofficial schedule the school doesn't count (Stanford 1945), or played a schedule the school counts but Howell doesn't list as major ('played': true: wartime schedules against service teams, New Mexico State's spring 2021); those games are in extra-games.json. None is a season in a lower division. The 1943-45 rows were researched 2026-09-29, each with a source and a verbatim quote. parse-jhowell.mjs merges a team's spans across a gap only when every season in the gap is listed here.

uconn.source: UConn canceled its 2020 season on 2020-08-05 (COVID-19); the first FBS program to do so.
